publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: In this paper, a tabu based neural network learning algorithm (TBBP) is represented to improve the function approximation ability of neural networks to nonlinear functions. By using the tabu search during the search process in the global area, the algorithm can escape from the local optimal solution and get a superior global optimization for the neural networks. The TBBP is tested in 6 different nonlinear functions. It is compared with the standard BP algorithm. The results show that the tabu search has improved the ability of the approximating ability of the neural networks

articleTitle: On the Delay-Dependent Stability and Stabilization of Linear Neutral Time-Delay Systems
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: In this paper, both problems of the stability and stabilization analysis for linear neutral time-delay systems are respectively investigated. The time-delays considered here are assumed bounded but no information to be available. Using Lyapunov functional method, delay-dependent conditions for the stability and stabilization of the systems are presented in terms of linear matrix inequality (LMI). A numerical example is given to illustrate the main results of this paper and make a comparison with the results presented in literatures

articleTitle: Adaptive Robust Reliable Controller for Uncertain Time-delay System with Actuator Failures
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: This paper deals with the design problem of adaptive robust reliable control for uncertain time-delay systems with actuator failures. A more practical model of actuator failures characterized by the average factor and the failure degree is adopted. A sufficient criterion for the existence of the adaptive robust reliable controller is derived in linear matrix inequality (LMI) framework and a design procedure of such controllers is presented. The designed reliable controller can tolerate such failures and guarantee the state variables of the closed-loop system to converge, globally, uniformly and exponentially, to a ball in the state space. The efficiency of our design method is finally verified by simulation on the river pollution control problem.

articleTitle: Event-Driven Model and Clustering Algorithm for the Single Airport Ground-Holding Problem
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: An effective method for reducing the delay cost in air traffic flow management is to use ground-holding policy (GHP) . A new single airport ground-holding event-driven model was present considering that the different aircraft has the different delay cost. Discrete-event analysis method was used to model for the problem. The concept of delay time equivalent quantity and the clustering algorithm were present to solve the combination optimization problem, which can shorten the computing time visibly. The simulation results using the Guangzhou airport data validate the feasibility of the proposed model and algorithm

articleTitle: Driving Comfort Assessment Model Construction Based on Fuzzy Inference
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: During the developing of auto industry, research on driving posture comfort has been the hot pursue in Computer Aided Auto Ergonomics Design (CAAED) realm, and static driving comfort angle is the kernel point of the whole problem. Traditional static comfort assessment only built models from auto driving space to comfort result. To converse it is difficult because the uncertain meaning of "COMFORT". This paper solves the problem by using "Mamdani" fuzzy logic to emulate the comfort assessment. Using this method, we could build fuzzy logic model between design parameters and comfort assessment, and feed the comfort result back to the design phase. Also, we emulate the algorithm in Matlab Fuzzy Toolkit, and develop a Computer Aided Auto Design prototype.

articleTitle: Robust Stability Criteria for TCP/AQM Networks with Time-Varying Delay
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: This paper proposes a robust stability analysis method for TCP/ AQM networks based on a time-varying structured uncertainties and time-varying delays control theory. Some delay-dependent stability criteria under which TCP/AQM system is global stability in terms of the error between instantaneous queue lengths and target queue length are devised. Since free weighting matrices are used to express the relationship between the terms in the Leibniz-Newton and appropriate ones are selected by means of linear matrix inequalities, the criteria is less conservative than existing ones. Numerical example demonstrates that this analytic method is effective.

articleTitle: Learning for Universal Logic Operation Selection
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Being an effective knowledge representation while using in a noisy, changing environment or system with full of sudden occurring events, symbolic logic should become more adaptive. In this paper, we introduce a method of fuzzy logical operator selection, which is mainly based on learning from examples. The adaptability of logic partially depends on the selective adapting of logical operators. In the binary logic, logical operation is fixed. Triangular norm theory made fuzzy logic and universal logic have the other choices on operation selection, but theoretically, the policy of choosing the proper operators in a special practical application among T-norm or T-conorm cluster is still a problem. General coefficient mechanism is a practical method for operation selection. Furthermore we introduce learning mechanism to keep the logic system more adaptive to the environment

articleTitle: A Markov Model Scheduling Method in Streaming Media Transmission
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: This paper analyzes the difficulties in the transmission of streaming media, makes research on the packet scheduling on the streaming media server. A Markov model is proposed under the effect of the complex dependency among the streaming media packets and the parameters of the transmission channel. On the basis of the Markov model, a policy is made on the queuing of the streaming media packets in the send buffer using the iteration method, which can maximize the playback quality under the lack of the channel bandwidth

articleTitle: A Texture Extraction Method Based on Local Binary Pattern Operator
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Most of image texture extraction methods are of high computational complexity, which hardly restricts their application in image processing fields. This paper proposes an improved local binary pattern operator to extract the image texture features. In the algorithm, single pixel is replaced with homogeneous object obtained by an object-oriented image segmentation method to exact image texture. At the same time, conditional probability is adopted as the parameter of image texture. The improvement makes it more valid to analysis object by fuzzy inference based image textures. In our experiments, the extracted image texture features are utilized for classifying images. The achieved good results indicate that the proposed method is faster than other methods while remaining close classification performance.

articleTitle: Research on an Improved GMDH-type Neural Network Based on Reconstruction of Phase Space
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: An improved GMDH-type neural network based on the reconstruction of phase space and its application to complex systems are proposed. The structure of the conventional GMDH (group method of data handling) neural network is fixed, and it is difficult to obtain the suitable threshold value and the output of the network is best in local. The new model of the GMDH-type neural network is improved in two ways: one is that GA and selection coefficients are adopted to get the best structure of the network and the best solution; the other is that the mean of the fitness function is used as the threshold value, in this way the necessary data are reserved and the needless terms are adequately omitted. The improved GMDH-type neural network proposed is fit for the prediction of chaotic time series and the result of the simulation demonstrates that the new network makes better performance than the conventional one

articleTitle: The Analysis of the Synchronization Condition of Linearly Coupled Chaotic System
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Describe the problem of chaos synchronization with precise mathematic theory, and in addition convert it to the analyze on the stability of the differential equations. Chen's system which is attached to the Lorenz's group has been introduced as the typical system, at the same time discusses the stability of the linear coupled chaotic system. Moreover a theorem which consists of the sufficient qualification attaining to the chaotic synchronization has been presented and in spite of this the paper also gives the detailed prove of the theorem. Avail the qualification discussed above, a method of identifying the coupled parameter is also given. Eventually, the conclusion of the simulation proves the valid of the theorem, besides, demonstrates the synchronization phenomenon of coupled system under different ways.

articleTitle: Multi-View Tracking in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Wireless sensor networks facilitate the robust intelligent sensing technology. Multi-sensor fusion improves the information's robustness and precision. For segmenting, detecting and tracking moving target with image sequences, signal-view tracking is easily impacted by obstacles and other disturbances, especially, when the target is blocked and/or makes significant motion, and original algorithm can not afford precise and continual tracking. This paper proposes a real-time robust moving target multi-view tracking technique based on wireless sensor networks (WSN), which contains two parts: moving region extraction and multi-view information fusion. First, extract moving region from image sequences of each sensor node with automatic thresholding change detection and brightness gradient adjustment. Second, fuse observational information of each node and analyze the 3D position of moving target with believed area combination method. The experimental results verify that the method has the ability of real-time robust tracking in complex background without any prior information of detected area, and it can also eliminate the infection of obstacles effectively

articleTitle: Study on optimum value of Grey Matrix Game Based on Token of Grey Interval Number
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Profit and loss matrix in the matrix game is made up of grey interval number because of that there are unsymmetrical information, finite knowledge and rational. This kind of game is called grey matrix game. Using thoughts of grey systems and theories of systems engineering, the paper studies pure strategy optimum grey game value and its solution, defines the concept of grey pure strategy solution, proves the sufficient and necessary condition of profit and loss relation and grey pure strategy solution. And based on this, studies the problems of optimum grey game value and it's solution under mixed strategy condition, sets up concepts of the most optimism and pessimism profit and loss matrix, and the concept of the optimization grey game value, studies the solution algorithm of max (min) grey game value. In the end, taking the decision-making of coal stores for winter warm as an example, the results show that it acquires well effect with the theories above.

articleTitle: Automatic Language Identification Using the Frequencies of Occurrence of Phones
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Phonetic inventories differ from language to language. Even when languages have identical phones, the frequencies of occurrence of phones differ across languages. It's difficult to introduce new languages when the language identification system used phones label. The frequencies of occurrence of phones were trained by Gaussian mixture model and vector quantization. The method of occurring of phones and three improved methods were compared. The results show that the frequencies of occurrence of phones are effective in language identification. The performance of GMM is better than the performance of VQ. And the third modified method of joint-usefulness is better than the other methods

articleTitle: An Extended Compensated Fuzzy C-Means Algorithm and Its Application in Optimizing the Acrylonitrile Reactor Parameters
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: An extended compensated fuzzy c-means (ECFCM) algorithm is proposed. Considering the relation that actually exists between input training data and clustering centers, grey relational coefficient is introduced to extend compensated fuzzy c-means (CFCM) algorithm. In addition, for expanding the applications of the proposed method, the function of clusters' integration and division is added into its run process so as to automatically obtain the rational number of clusters. Our simulated experiments demonstrate that the results of the proposed method applied to analysis of the iris data and the wine data outperform those of other methods. Furthermore, a practical application in classifying the acrylonitrile reactor data is also provided. The experimental results show that the ECFCM algorithm with the function of classes' integration and division can obtain the rational number of clusters and better clustering performance. Higher yields can be obtained by regulating the acrylonitrile reactor parameters according to the clustering results. Therefore, the ECFCM algorithm can be well applied to optimizing the acrylonitrile reactor parameters

articleTitle: A New Method and Implement of Traffic Condition for Intelligent Transportation System
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Firstly, the shortage of traditional detection method of traffic conditions are analyzed. Secondly, this paper proposed a new detection method of traffic conditions -virtual detector which is based on GPS/INS technology, short message service and local supervise station. By virtue of the instantaneous velocity of vehicles and precise time information are detected by virtual detector, a mathematic model can be established, a series of important traffic condition information can be obtained, such as traffic volume, mean velocity, driving time, drive way occupancy, etc. This technology realizes the real-time and random detection of city traffic condition and offers the premise for traffic signal control system, traffic-streaming guidance system.

articleTitle: Research on Spatial-Temporal Information Fusion System for Sensor Networks Node Cluster
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: In order to solve general phenomena of uncertainty, unintegrity and redundancy, and receive the habitus accurately and reorganization and the decision information of the object fully in the multi-source information fusion of sensor networks node cluster. The spatial and temporal fusion must be taken into account. A novel spatial-temporal two-layer architecture model is presented. In the architecture, using D-S evidence theory and support degree, the data that is monitored by different sensor at the same time is fused first, and then using fuzzy integral, support degree and genetic algorithm, the data that is fused in space is fused in time order. It indicates by simulation that the distributed multi-source information fusion system has famous capability for target detection, resisting the environmental disturbance and fault-tolerance

articleTitle: Online Chinese Character Recognition Based on Force Vector
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Force Sensitive Tablet(F-Tablet) is a novel handwriting input device, it can capture two dimention torque and three dimention force information directly. With the force and torque information, Handwriting Recognition and Signature Verification will be more efficient. This paper discusses a Handwriting Recognition process which firstly utilizes the novel force data to extract strokes of Chinese characters and then builds HMM to recognize each stroke. So the basic notion is stroke-HMM, which is widely used in the Online Chinese Character Recognition(OCCR). To recognize the whole character, the Chinese Character library based on strokes is built. Hence, once the strokes of a character is given, the character could be found quickly throughout the library. At the same time, some experiment result is given either.

articleTitle: Driving Status' Monitoring and Alarming System Based on Information Fusion Technology
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: This paper designs a system based on multisensor information fusion technology, which is for monitoring driving status, alarming and controlling. In order to improve the processing capability, it adopts special parallel processing channel of image and C/S structure, which consists of video-disposing-, non-video-disposing and control sections. The system can simultaneously monitor drivers' pupil size and blinking, angle between drivers' head and uprightness, driving direction, etc. The veracity of system will be strengthened to judge the drivers' fatigue driving status through information fusion technology

articleTitle: Coking Optimization Control Model Based on Hierarchical Multi-objective Evolutionary Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Through the analysis of all optimized objectives in coking process, blending ratio is extracted as a key variable, and a model for coking optimization control is presented. Adopting evolutionary algorithm in each layer of multiple multi-objective optimization, hierarchical multi-objective evolutionary algorithm is put forward. Based on this hierarchical structure, four optimization objectives in coking optimization model are grouped into two layers. Detailed evolutionary strategy in each layer is discussed. Simulation results indicate blending ratio computed by the model can increase production efficiency, decrease cost and energy wastage greatly. Comparison of blending ratio computed under different objective weights proves this model can satisfy the requirement of different production objectives. All these show that the model plays an important directive role in coking production structure optimization

articleTitle: Design of a New Type of Hysteresis Compensator Based on Sliding Mode Principle
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Aiming at a kind of typical dynamic hysteresis model which can be used to describe hysteresis characteristic of piezoceramic actuator, a new kind of hysteretic compensating control strategy based on sliding mode principle is proposed. The sliding mode Compensator can transform the practical hysteretic characteristic into an ideal hysteretic characteristic effectively. Then, the multi-valued nonlinear mapping can be transferred to a single-valued linear mapping. The simulation results show the validity of the sliding mode compensator for the hysteretic characteristic.

articleTitle: Modeling Plasma Modification of Glass Surface using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: In order to understand the relationship between discharge plasma parameters and material surface properties, neural networks model was constructed. The sample data were yielded from a lot of experiments for glass surface hydrophobic treatment. The experiments were arranged according to uniform design method and conducted using atmospheric pressure dielectric barrier discharge (DBD). Three discharge parameters, such as voltage, frequency and treatment time, were viewed as the inputs of the model. The outputs of the model were glass surface water contact angles. Back-propagation algorithm was used to train neural networks model. Model evaluation was carried out by simulation and error analysis. The optimized model was applied to predict, and the results are in agreement with practical situation. The obtained neural networks model has excellent predictive capability.

articleTitle: Parametric Bispectrum Analysis of Cracked Rotor Based on Blind Identification of Time Series Models
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: The crack is a very serious defect in the rotor system. However, compared with any other defects, diagnosis of the rotor crack is more difficult, and its potential harm is similarly very serious. Therefore, it is very urgent and necessary to detect and diagnose the rotor crack effectively. In this paper, an approach of bispectrum analysis based on blind identification of time series model is proposed, and this approach is then applied to the fault diagnosis of the rotor crack. The bispectrum characteristics of the cracked rotor with cracks of different depth and location are investigated, and some valuable results are obtained. This approach provides a new idea and method for the diagnosis of the rotor crack. The experimental results show that this approach is very effective

articleTitle: A System Level Low Power Static Real-Time Scheduling Algorithm of Mixed Tasks and Its Application to FTU
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: FTU (feeder terminal unit) is an important device of distribution automation system, always working in bad environment. Its power dissipation and related thermal issues affect the lifetime of circuit component. When blackout in power grid comes forth, FTU will be working normally powered by the battery. Reducing the power of FTU can increase the normally working time and then increase the power grid's reliability. Traditionally, studies on energy reduction techniques of FTU have been conducted in the circuit design. Based on these previous studies, a system level low power static real-time scheduling algorithm of mixed tasks is proposed for FTU in this paper. The simulation experiment shows that this algorithm can decrease the FTU power consumption effectively

articleTitle: Design of the New Multi-purpose Running State Recorder for Automobile Based on CF Card
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: A new multi-purpose running state recorder for automobile is introduced. It overcomes the limitations of conventional recorder of little memory, difficult to be extended and data to be uploaded for a long time. The recorder, with C8051F005 as kernel, adopting serial interface RTC MAX6902 and CF card, can monitor and record running state of automobile in real time. The recorded data can be uploaded to upper computer through universal card reader for daily management and accident diagnosis

articleTitle: Implementation of Neural Network Learning with Minimum L1-Norm Criteria in Alpha Stable Distribution
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Minimum L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>-norm optimization model has found extensive applications in linear parameter estimations. L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>-norm model is robust in non Gaussian alpha stable distribution error or noise environments, especially for signals that contain sharp transitions or dynamic processes. However, its implementation is more difficult due to discontinuous derivatives, especially compared with the least-squares model. In this paper, a new neural network for solving L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>-norm optimization problems is presented. It has been proved that this neural network is able to converge to the exact solution to a given problem. Implementation of L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>-norm optimization model is presented, where a new neural network is constructed and its performance is evaluated theoretically and experimentally

articleTitle: A Real-time Algorithm for Music Recognition Based on Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: This paper presents a new real-time algorithm for music recognition. According to music characteristics, we analyzed spectrum at the music pitches frequencies by using wavelet transform and DTFT, which increases not only the computing efficiency but also the resistance to noise. We advance a recognition strategy of note voting and music segmentation. New recognition rules for chords recognition are also presented. Experimental results show that our algorithm is fast and effective

articleTitle: An Active Disturbances Rejection Controller for Hysteretic Systems
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: An active disturbances rejection controller is presented for a class of single-input- single-output nonlinear systems with an unknown hysteresis nonlinearity represented by the Preisach model. The active disturbances rejection controller is composed of the nonlinearity tracking differentiator, the extended state observer and the nonlinearity PID. It can estimate disturbances and compensate, according to the information between the input and the output of the controlled object. Thus it automatically realizes the suppression of disturbance. The result of simulation indicates: The ADRC controller with one set of invariable parameters can maintain that nonlinear systems with an unknown hysteresis nonlinearity has ideal tracking effect.

articleTitle: Speed Estimation of Sensorless Vector Control System Based on Single Neuron PI Controller
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: A novel adaptive speed estimation method of an induction motor is presented in this paper. This speed-sensorless vector control system is based on a flux observer and a single neuron PI controller (SNPIC). The flux observer is used to provide q-axis rotor flux for rotor speed estimation. The SNPIC is used for the realization of speed estimation instead of conventional PI controller utilizing q-axis rotor flux converging on zero. The designed method has the advantages of simple structure and good robustness. The simulation results show that the proposed scheme has good performance at either variable–speed operation or load variation and low sensitivity to load disturbances compared with conventional PI control scheme.

articleTitle: Single Machine Scheduling with Nonlinear Processing Times and Learning Effect*
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: The problem of scheduling n jobs on a single machine is investigated, where the concept of deteriorating and the learning effect are considered simultaneously. In this model, the optimal schedule of the problem may be different from that of the classical version of the problem. We prove some properties of the problems for the following optimization criteria: makespan and total completion time. Based on these properties, we introduce polynomial solutions for some special problems.

articleTitle: A sparsely Distributed and Statistically Independent Representation of Parallel Fiber Coding in Cerebellum
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Continuous and real-time learning is a difficult problem in robotics. This paper investigates how learning in the input layer of the cerebellum may successfully encode contextual knowledge in a representation useful for coordination and lifelong learning, and proposes that a sparsely distributed and statistically independent representation provides a valid criterion for the self-organizing classification and integration of context signals. This representation is beneficial for learning in the cerebellum by simplifying the credit assignment problem between what must be learned and the relevant signals in the current context for learning it and for life-long learning by reducing the destructive interference across tasks, while retaining the ability to generalize

articleTitle: Time Series Prediction Based on Lazy Learning
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Lazy learning is a kind of novel machine learning methods based on statistical learning theory, which based on memory learning strategy. In the literature, it is generally used for non-linear system identification and function estimation. This paper applies lazy learning to time series prediction. Unlike conventional time series similar analysis, the whole similarity and the individual similarity are discussed. A new similar criterion combined the two similar characters is advanced. Using this criterion and locally weighted learning, one-step-ahead predictors for time series forecasting is achieved. For each single one-step- ahead prediction, the best predictive value will be obtained based on leave-one-out cross validation. In order to show the effectiveness of our method, we present the results obtained on a real-world dataset from the Santa Fe competition and Henon map.

articleTitle: Research on Clustering Fusion Control System Applied to Circulating Fluidized Bed Boilers Combustion Process of Giant Domestic Manufacture
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Based on the dynamic behavior of circulating fluidized bed (CFB) boilers, an information fusion and cluster control system (for short cluster fusion control system-CFCS) based on information fusion technology is bring proposed. The data from multisensors that can be clustered together to reflect the working condition are fused to CFCS. Thus the control scheme corresponding to the progress can be adopted to realize effective control. Satisfaction results have obtained with the CFCS applied to 220 t/h circulating fluidized bed boilers of domestic manufacture

articleTitle: Study on Knowledge Integration System Oriented to Product Design
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Aimed at the shortages of existing knowledge integration system that couldn't integrate distributed knowledge well, an open framework of knowledge integration system oriented to product design was proposed. The main function models and key technologies were analyzed. The process of product design based on knowledge integration system was studied. According to knowledge expression and reasoning technologies, the knowledge expression and reasoning system was established and the product model was depicted with XML. A novel fuzzy consistent method was proposed to search product model. Finally a prototype system of knowledge integration is developed for auto parts and it realizes eddy current retarder design based on knowledge integration

articleTitle: A Dynamic Alignment Hybrid Ant-Clustering Algorithm for Aerial Attack Directions Judgment Problem
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: An improved ant-clustering algorithm is designed and realized. In relation to aerial attack directions judgment problem, the deficiencies of traditional clustering algorithms which can be used to deal with the problem are analyzed. A dynamic alignment hybrid ant-clustering algorithm for solving the problem is designed based on the ant-clustering characters of needn't inputting the initial parameter of clustering number, good robustness, visualization etc. The improved ant-clustering algorithm can make full use of aerial target information and dynamically align parameters to gain the reasonable clustering number and accelerate convergence. Furthermore, the algorithm has good robustness when dealing with the isolated data. The experiment results demonstrate that the new algorithm improves the precision and reasonableness in solving aerial attack directions judgment problem.

articleTitle: Measure and Equilibrium Analysis of Financial Innovation Motivity Based on Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: By analyzing the interplay between government and financial institution as well as each behavior, a new model measuring financial innovation motivity has been obtained based on game theory. The financial innovation motivity was defined and measured in the government effective strategic set. The subgame perfect Nash equilibrium in grim strategies of government and financial institution was also proved and analyzed. The results show that one-period finite extended game will generate inferior strategies leading to "a trap blocking financial innovation", while infinitely repeated games will generate best dominant strategies for all players' decisions. Besides, the main variables have been given out taking account the heterogeneity in players' payoff when developing the infinitely repeated games model. The model constructs a span-new frame for studying the competitive and strategic interplay between players in financial innovation

articleTitle: Local Maximum Component-labeling Based on Parallel Local Operation Sequence for Layout Analysis
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: A definition of the local maximum component (the component for short) is presented for layout analysis in document image analysis (DIA), and a novel algorithm for component labeling was described. This algorithm uses a contour tracing technique to detect and label the external contour of each component, and removes the interior area of each component from the copy of the source image. Labeling and removing are completed in a single pass over source image. Experiments on various kinds of images (title, text, picture, table and formula) show that the new definition and algorithm are more efficient and flexible than the traditional labeling ones.

articleTitle: Mission Reliability Evaluation of Development System Based on BDD Method
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Iteration is one of main factors that influence mission time of development system. Mission reliability is analyzed under consideration of influence of iteration in mission. At first, the definition of incremental time ratio in iteration is given. Cut set is solved by a new kind of method derived by BDD method through analysis of path of development net. BBD method is used to disjoint cut set, and then mission reliability is solved. An example is given to explain this algorithm. The algorithm is valid and simple.

articleTitle: The Design of Soft Starter for AC Motors Based on Single Neuron PI Regulator
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Soft starters are being used as induction motor starters in fan or pump drives, etc, the principle of which is based on the control of variable voltage and constant frequency. In the paper, we develop a kind of intelligent soft-starter for AC motors based on TMS320F240 digital signal processor (DSP). The method of designing the system that includes hardware and software is introduced. A new method of single neuron PI regulation is proposed to improve robustness and self-adaptation capacity of this system. It is proved by experiment that the system has excellent performance

articleTitle: Area Industrial Networked Manufacturing Based on Synergistic Effect Coupled with Its Cooperation-level Analyses
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: It is one of the important factors to generate synergistic effect among different enterprises to possess similar properties concerning production, market or technology. Such kind of similarity of the enterprise could be classified by industries and the area manufacture present as industrial economics. Therefore, it can obtain natural advantage to employ the policy of area industrial networked manufacture. The mathematics model of synergistic effect for area industrial networked manufacture is raised. Also it elucidates the hierarchical architecture both for the networked cooperative activities and the CSCW information platform. The practical results showed that the networked cooperative manufacture linked by areas and industries could reduce producing cycle and manufacturing cost resorting to the synergistic effect

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Vehicle Detection and Image Capture Based on Adaptive Background
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: A novel method to obtain adaptive background from dynamic scene is proposed in the paper. Through computing the difference between neighbouring frames, the states of pixels were attained. The values of marking matrix are modified according to relative moving states and punished by different position. When the value of matrix's element is equal to zero, the pixel in corresponding position belongs to background. Pixel is moving only when it is in moving state through computing the difference of neighborhood frames and difference between current frame and background frame. It also gives relating parameters, which have relation to occasion for image capture. Experiments show that the results of detecting and capturing the moving objects are ideal. And it can exclude disturbance of pedestrians and moving vehicles in adjacent lanes

articleTitle: A New Method of Single Color Face Detection Based on Skin Model and Gaussian Distribution
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: The speed and the accuracy of face detection are both very important for network sensors applied in human-computer interface. A new method of face detection, which is based on skin color clustering features and the characteristic that the projection of facial pixels onto the Euclidean Space with two dimensions is similar to the Gaussian distribution, is presented in this paper. Firstly, this approach utilizes the skin color features to transform the original image into a binary-image. Then, two curves are obtained by projecting the binary-image to X and Y axes respectively, from which Gaussian curves are calculated. Finally, an accurate face region is found through the solution of Gaussian equation. Simulation shows that the proposed method is fast in detection and needs less computation

articleTitle: Apply Study on Evaluation Techniques for Oil Gas Reservoir Based on Neural Networks Techniques
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: By applying principle of computer artificial nerve network's and arithmetic of error reversion transmission, and by making parameters of gas logging quantified and standardized, it can establish the interpretation model of artificial nerve network, of which the inputting model sample is based on many parameters. Summing up various data of comprehensive logging can solve the problems of low accurate rate for identifying oil gas and water layer. The logging nerve network is a new method, which is effective for evaluating and interpreting oil gas and water layer synthetically. It is prove by practice, the overall coincidence rate of interpretation reaches 97%.

articleTitle: Characteristics of the Microrobot Moving in the Vertical Pipe
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: In this paper, to realize practical micromachines using fluid power with high power density. It is our purpose to develop motion control system to manipulate a wireless microrobot which can perform in blood vessel by using magnetic field from out of human body. Base on this purpose, a new novel type moving microrobot in pipe has been designed and introduced in this paper. The model microrobot utilizes electromagnetic actuator as the servo actuator to realize moving motion for biomedical application. We discuss the structure, motion mechanism and characteristic evaluation of a driving fin which be in charge of propulsion. The fin moving like fish can be controlled by the frequency adjustment of the alternate magnetic field. The microrobot can be stopped at the place where we want in vertical direction. Experimental results indicate that the microrobot can be controlled upward, downward and also suspend in water by frequency adjustment. The developed microrobot has characteristics of quick response, can correspond to the dirt adhering to the inner wall. To sum up, it will play an important part in industrial application and microsurgery.

articleTitle: Application of Neural Network Based on Simulated Annealing to Classification of Remote Sensing Image
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: The performance was unstable when using BP neural network to classify remote sensing images. Applying simulated annealing idea, an improved BP neural network with momentum was put forward. The improved network could self-adapt to choose momentum parameters according to annealing temperature, which was able to make the network escape from local minimum spots and converge stably. The experiments show that improved network converges more easily, its performance is steady, it has the preponderances of gradient descent with momentum and the standard BP neural network. Classification accuracy of remote sensing image is comparatively high. This method has practical application value

articleTitle: Kernel Method for Building Fuzzy Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: This paper investigates the connection between modified fuzzy basis function (MFBF)-based classifiers and support vector classifiers, establishes a link between fuzzy rules and kernels, and proposes a new approach to build MFBF-based classifiers. Under some minor constrains, the equivalence of the two seemingly quite distinct classifiers is proved. Moreover, the kernel method has the inherent advantage that the MFBF-based classifiers do not have to determine the number of rules in advance. The designed classifier can be represented as a decision function consisting of series expansion of MFBFs, and this also makes itself to be interpretable. The performance of the proposed approach is illustrated by IRIS data sets and comparisons with other methods are also provided

articleTitle: Robust Adaptive Control of Polynomial Lower-Triangular Systems with Dynamic Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of robust adaptive control for a class of nonlinear systems, called polynomial lower-triangular form (pLTF), which not only expands LTF to a more general case, but also consists of three types of uncertainties: parametric uncertainties, uncertain nonlinearities and dynamic uncertainties. The proposed design approach joins the tool of power integrator with small-gain techniques. Firstly, via the recursive design, an adaptive controller is formulated to render the systems robust with respect to static uncertainties. Secondly, by the small-gain theorem, we show under the condition the adaptive controller guarantees the robustness property of the systems in the presence of dynamic uncertainties. Finally, an example is provided to illustrate the validity of the design

articleTitle: Statistical Dependences of Images Coefficients in Contourlet Domain: Analyzing and Modeling
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new scheme based on contourlet to compress the natural images with contours and oscillatory patterns. The contourlet transform, having the properties of multiscale, local, and multidirection expansion, is used as the non-linear image approximation method to decompose the images. With a detail study of the statistics of the contourlet coefficients of natural images, the individual behaviours and correlations of contourlet coefficients across scales, positions and directions are measured respectively. Results reveal that the contourlet coefficients have strong local dependencies and clustering when the coeffecients are at low amplitude. Based on these findings, a new embedded block with significance sorting model is developed to present the transformed coefficients. Using the strategy of significance sorting, the proposed model can deal with both the significant coefficients in different subbands and the set of massive insignificant coefficients. Experimental results demonstrate that this approach is closed to the wavelet coder in terms of the PSNR metric, and visually superior to the wavelet coder for the images with detailed texture.

articleTitle: Control Information Acquisition of a Magnetic Suspended Hard Disk Drive
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: The way of control information acquisition of a magnetic suspended hard disk drive (HDD) is studied. The expression and calculation formula for the control information of a magnetic suspended hard disk drive is given. The influence on performance characteristic of a magnetic suspended hard disk drive caused by different structure parameters is also evaluated. Based on the study above the way in which to acquiring control information in different structure design of a magnetic suspended hard disk drive is illustrated

articleTitle: Simulation Studies of Truck Configuration in a Container Terminal
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: In this paper, we consider the problem of truck configuration in a container terminal. A model is built using the Witness simulation software to simulate the process of a ship's handling and transportation. It is based on the reality of a large container terminal in China. The transportation network for container truck is reproduced in the model from the quay side to the container yard. Input data include the parameters in a generic format such as lengths of paths, quantity and speed of vehicles, the operation mode. Therefore, the model is adjustable to many situations. The paper analyzes the output results through running the model, and examines whether the quantity and the speed of the container trucks have influenced the handling time and how much it is. The study indicates that the quantity should be configured dynamically according to different stages of handling, and that raising the speed of the trucks would not necessarily improve the handling efficiency. The object-oriented method proves quite effective in developing the simulation model, resulting in a reliable and adjustable model

articleTitle: The FDTD Analysis of EMI in Motor Drive System
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: In motor drive system, the high dv / dt and di / dt due to the fast switching of IGBT could bring serious EMI issue. This paper proposes an EMI analysis method which combines with the test and simulation based on Finite-Difference Time-Domain (FDTD). The excitation source of FDTD is obtained by testing EMI of drive system and is added the input of simulation system, then the EMI coupling path is analyzed. On the one hand, EMI has many frequency spectrums, which computes wide-band S parameter. On the other hand, the method is of practical significance for analyzing EMI inside different system because the excitation source signal derives practical drive system. This paper analyzes the EMI of PWM drive system and puts forward the algorithm principle of FDTD based on EMI. The error of Simulation and experiment results is less than 10dB. Simulation and experiment results are presented to indicate validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Real-time Planning and Control Strategy of Humanoid Robot Walking on Irregular Terrain
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Improving environmental adaptability is a key to the humanoid robot research. A strategy of real-time planning and control was proposed in the paper based on F/T information feedback. The robot lands it's whole sole on the ground by adopting ankle's moment control, calculates the parameters of gait and plans current step based on stability criterion. During walking, posture is real-time regulated according to the information of ZMP to realize the stability. In the end, the walking process was simulated and experiments were developed to confirm this strategy

articleTitle: A Framework of Multi-Agent Professional Search Engine Based on Rough Set and Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: To meet the requirement, analyzing and mining on Web content based on machine learning is a major tendency of the computer science. This paper proposes a framework of multi-agent professional search engine system based on rough set and data mining. We build a multi-agent system, analyze the Web content based on rough set and data mining and enhance the learning capability of the agent based on Bayesian method. By this means, we can optimize the search strategies and improve the intelligence of search engine. Lastly, the architecture and implementation of ASE is discussed, and the performance is tested.

articleTitle: Optimal Control of a Class of Non-Linear Discrete-Continuous Hybrid Systems
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: This work is derived for solving a non-linear discrete-continuous systems optimal control problem by iterating on a sequence of simplified problems in linear quadratic form. A mixed approach with a discrete performance index and continuous state variable system description is used as the basis of the design, and it is shown how the global problem can be decomposed into local sub-system problems and a coordinator within a hierarchical framework, so the problem become simple. The correct optimal solution of a real system in which model-reality difference exists can be obtained from system model by interconnected co-state prediction iterative solution. An analysis of the optimality and convergence properties of the algorithm is presented and the efficiency of the technique is demonstrated

articleTitle: Spacecraft Vibration Damping Using Shaped Command Input
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: This investigation is to apply the so-called component synthesis vibration suppression (CSVS) based feed-forward control and the conventional PD feedback control to the vibration control of a flexible spacecraft. The proposed control design process is two fold: design of the attitude controller followed by the design of a flexible vibration attenuator. The attitude control law design is based on the Lyapunov stability theory to achieve a stabilizing closed-loop system. The shaped command input controller based on the CSVS method is designed for the reduction of the flexible vibration by modifying the command input, which only requires information about the natural frequency and damping of the closed-loop system. To extend the CSVS method to the system with the on-off actuators, the pulse-width pulse-frequency (PWPF) modulation is introduced to control the thruster firing and integrated with the CSVS method. The simulation results have been proven the potential of this technique to control flexible spacecraft.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm for Location-Routing Problem
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Location-routing problem is a kind of hard combinatorial optimization problem that arose in supply chain and logistic system. A genetic algorithm was designed to solve the problem. Novel genetic representation and corresponding genetic operations were used in the genetic algorithm so that the location-allocation and vehicle-routing can be tackled simultaneously. Computer simulation shows that the proposed algorithm is effective

articleTitle: Resilient Robust Fuzzy Controller Design for a Class of Nonlinear Systems with Time Delays
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Resilient robust fuzzy control problem is addressed for a class of nonlinear systems with time delays via state feedback controller. The system is represented by Takagi-Sugeno (T-S) fuzzy model with norm-bounded and time-varying uncertainties in the matrices of state, delayed state, input and control gain. Parallel-distributed compensation (PDC) scheme is utilized to design resilient robust fuzzy controller, in which the small perturbations in the coefficients of the controller design are taken into account. Sufficient conditions are presented for the existence of resilient robust fuzzy controllers in the form of linear matrix inequalities (LMI), which can be solved by some popular commercial software. Finally, an example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed results

articleTitle: Study on Optimal Placement for Piezoelectric Smart Flexible Cantilever Plate
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Some flexible appendages of spacecraft are cantilever plate structures, such as sun plate, piezoelectric smart structure is used to suppress the vibration due to the parameter uncertainties and environmental disturbances. An energy-based optimal placement strategy for the placement of piezoelectric actuators/sensors in active vibration suppression of flexible plate is adopted. Based on the degree of observability and controllability of the dynamical model including bending and torsion modes, the input matrix was properly weighted according to the contribution to observability and controllability for corresponding modes, the optimal placement indices of the candidate sensor and actuator locations are adopted by means of controllability gramian matrix. The experimental facility of piezoelectric smart plate for active vibration control was designed and built up, identification of the flexible cantilever plate system is investigated, the experimental results verified that the optimal strategy is feasible.

articleTitle: A Method of PID Controller Parameter Optimization Based on AB Immune Network Model
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: In some uncertain systems, parameters of PID controller are still difficult to tune. The main reason is that it is difficult to solve conflicts between static state performance and dynamic performance, track and restrain disturb, robustness and control performance. To overcome those demerits, a PID parameter optimization algorithm, which used the idea of immune genetic algorithm, was proposed in this paper. This new algorithm used an AB immune network model to simulate interaction between antibodies and to calculate concentration of antibody, and it was able to converge to the optimum parameters fast and efficiently according to the given controlled system. The simulation results show the improvement in convergent speed, global stability and robustness of the PID controller efficiently

articleTitle: Application of Snake Model Based on PSO in the Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: For exactly segmenting the object in the image, an algorithm of image segmentation according to PSO (particle swarm optimization) and snake model was proposed. The PSO has some advantages, such as the global optimization, sensitive degree low for noise. The drawbacks of the traditional snake model which are the high noise sensitive degree and local optimization are overcome by the combination of PSO and snake. It is proved by experiment that preferable image segmentation result is gotten based on the algorithm

articleTitle: Observer Design for a Class of MO Nonlinear Systems
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Under the boundedness and observability conditions, we present a globally convergent observer for a class of multi-output nonlinear systems which covers the block-triangular observer forms studied previously in the literature. The result presented in this short note incorporates and generalizes the earlier work on the observer design for single-output observable systems.

articleTitle: Adaptive Control of Nonlinear Systems with Unknown Control Directions
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: The robust adaptive state feedback controller is designed for a class of nonlinear systems with unknown time-varying virtual control coefficients, uncertain time-varying nonlinear parameters and uncontrollable unstable linearization, by employing the Nussbaum-type gain technique and the adding a power integrator design. The controller can ensure all the signals of closed-loop globally uniformly bounded. Especially, the state signals asymptotically convergence to zero. The proposed design method does not require any a priori knowledge of the unknown control coefficients except for their bounds.

articleTitle: Hybrid GA and Backstepping based Tracking Control of a Mobile Robot
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: In this paper, a hybrid genetic algorithm (GA) and backstepping based tracking controller is proposed for a nonholonomic mobile robot. Backstepping is a commonly used technique for nonlinear control systems. By using a backstepping motion controller alone, there exist oscillations at the initial phase in both linear velocity and angular velocity, as well as a big initial linear velocity jump. A genetic algorithm is used to optimize the parameters of the backstepping controller. The hybrid controller is capable of removing the velocity oscillations and speed jump. In addition, it can guarantee the system stability and convergence of tracking error. The effectiveness of the proposed hybrid control is demonstrated by simulation studies.

articleTitle: Hybrid modeling and simulation of wet flue gas desulphurization process
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: During the development of simulation model of wet flue gas desulphurization (WFGD) in power plant the ordinary differential equations model is developed for the part about which the knowledge is completed. On the other hand based on qualitative knowledge and few data samples a fuzzy T-S model is developed for the part about which the complete knowledge is not obtained. The way to construct the fuzzy T-S simulation model based on the qualitative knowledge and few sample data of the complex system is also discussed. A hybrid real-time simulation model of WFGD is obtained which include quantitive model based on first-law of system and qualitative model. The simulation result indicate the way of hybrid modeling and simulation is effective for modeling and simulation of complex system

articleTitle: Decentralized Robust H∞ Output Feedback Control for Value Bounded Uncertain Large-scale Interconnected Systems
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: For large-scale interconnected systems with value bounded uncertainties existing in the state, control and interconnected matrices, the design of a decentralized robust H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">infin</sub> output feedback controller is investigated. Based on the bounded real lemma sufficient conditions for the existence of a decentralized robust H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">infin</sub> controller are obtained in terms of a set of matrix inequalities. According to Schur complement, a homotopy iterative linear matrix inequality method is put forward to construct a decentralized robust H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">infin</sub> controller by fixing different variables. The controller obtained enables the closed-loop large-scale systems robust stable and satisfies the given H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">infin</sub> performance. At last a numerical example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the offered method

articleTitle: An Improved Variable-Length Representation Approach for Knapsack Problem
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: One of the methods to solve knapsack problem is the variable-length representation approach based on genetic algorithm (GA). The original variable-length representation approach has the problem of low efficiency. In this paper we present a improved approach. In the early stage of the evolution, the heuristic searching method is applied to search better solutions rapidly, and in the latter part of evolution the random searching method is applied to improve the result. Through the simulation on some benchmark and two random knapsack problems, the results show that the improved variable-length representation approach has superiority in speed and accuracy over the standard method

articleTitle: A Hybrid Algorithm for Scheduling Problems of Flow Shop with Uncertain Processing Time
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Scheduling is a very complex but important problem, and there are various uncertainties in the real production scheduling process. A fuzzy scheduling model for flow shop problems with uncertain processing time has been presented based on fuzzy programming theory, in which the uncertain processing can be dealt with by the fuzzy operators. The fuzzy model can be transformed to the optimal programming model and the worst programming model by the fuzzy cut-set. And a hybrid algorithm combined the Immune Algorithm with the Branch and Bound method is proposed to solving the model, which can avoid the blind search of the Immune Algorithm. Finally, simulation results have shown that the effectiveness of the fuzzy scheduling model and the high searching efficiency of the hybrid method.

articleTitle: Research on Fast Initialization for the Level Set Method
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: A novel composite approach for initializing the level set method is proposed. The initialization is computational time-consuming and crucial for the application of the level set method, such as image segmentation. The composite algorithm is based on the fast marching method and the implicit iteration method, and moreover, the advantages of two methods are respectively incorporated in our algorithm. Firstly a simple labeling approach based on the fast marching method is developed in this algorithm. The signature function is suitably modified to solve the numerical stability problems when the implicit iterative method is used to the construction of the signed distance function. At last, comparison with the previous algorithms shows that the proposed approach is accurate, simple and efficient.

articleTitle: Heuristic Algorithm of Scheduling Model for Cold Coils Annealing
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Treated as the no-wait hybrid flow workshop scheduling problem, the annealing operation of cool steel coils in the annealing workshop of the cold rolling plant of an iron and steel corporation is discussed. A mathematical model is established and the corresponding heuristic algorithm is designed

Author Keywords: Annealing operation of cool steel coils

articleTitle: Indefinite Stochastic LQ Control with Markovian Jumps via Semidefinite Programming (I)
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: This paper studies a stochastic linear-quadratic (LQ) control problem over an infinite time horizon with Markovian jumps in parameter values, allowing the weighting matrices in the cost to be indefinite. Coupled generalized algebraic Riccati equations (CGAREs) involving pseudo inverse of a matrix are introduced. It is shown that the solvability of the LQ problem boils down to that of the CGAREs. However, the system of the CGAREs is hard to treat. To overcome this difficulty, the corresponding semidefinite programming (SDP) and related duality are utilized. Several implication relations among the SDP complementary duality, the existence of the solution to the CGAREs and the optimality of LQ problem are established. A numerical procedure that provides a thorough treatment of the LQ problem via primal-dual SDP is presented: it identifies a stabilizing optimal feedback control or determines that the LQ problem has no optimal solution

articleTitle: A Method of Kernel Fisher Discriminant for Multi-class Classification
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Kernel Fisher Discriminant Analysis (KFD) has good performance in practice as a classification method. However, KFD is initially developed for binary classification. To solving multi-class classification problems, Multi-class KFD (MKFD) was designed to minimize total deviation. By Lagrange Multiplier method, MKFD was transformed to be a quadratic optimization problem that can avoid solving eigenproblem and be less numerical demanding relatively. Moreover it is shown that MKFD is a direct generalization of the binary classification. Finally the performance of MKFD was tested on the benchmark datasets in experiments. The results support usefulness of MKFD, compared with other methods such as support vector machines.

articleTitle: Closed-loop Online Related Identification of Diesel Engine
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: The prerequisite of closed-loop identification of diesel engine is presented. The low-order equivalent linear model of diesel engine 12V180ZJ is established, based on the identification algorithm COR-I/O. The influence to the system dynamics of a small time-delay comparing with the system lag is analyzed. The identification test and simulation result indicate that the algorithm is practical and reasonable

articleTitle: Algorithms of Analyzing RLC Electrical Network Structure
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: In order to intelligently analyze RLC structural properties of electrical network over F(z), it is the base to analyze the network structure automatically. This paper mainly expatiates on some important algorithms to search nodes, loops, twigs and links, and judge whether there are some errors about short circuit, all-voltage source loop and all-current source cut-set in network. Practice shows that these algorithms are effective and could solve the difficulties in traditional manually analyzing method and make our research task be finished ahead of schedule.

articleTitle: An Application of Desulphurization Pretreatment of Molten Iron using Parallel Kernel Regression RBF NN
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Kernel regression of RBF NN building on the notion of density estimation is frequently used for modeling prediction. But kernel matrix computation for high dimensional data source demands heavy computing power. To shorten the computing time, the paper designs a parallel algorithm to compute the kernel function matrix of kernel regression of RBF NN. The proposed algorithm has been applied to desulphurization pretreatment of molten iron in metallurgical process to build the prediction of desulphurization pretreatment modeling. The paper then implements the algorithm on a cluster of computing workstations using MPI. Finally, we experiment with the practical data to prove the speedups and accuracy of the algorithm

articleTitle: A Clustering Algorithm Based on Mathematical Morphology
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Mathematical Morphology is basically a set theory. It provides the concept of a structuring element to probe the image with arbitrary geometric patterns. A novel clustering algorithm based on mathematical morphology is presented. First, the data set is discretized, and then clusters are detected as well separated subsets by a hierarchical morphological operation procedure. An algorithm to determine connected components allows us to estimate the number of clusters. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed clustering algorithm is able to cluster complex shaped data set better than the classical clustering algorithms, and find an optimal number of clusters.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Convergence Speed for an Open and Closed Loop Second Order Iterative Learning Control Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: An open-closed-loop second-order iterative learning control algorithm is investigated in the presence of the system uncertainties. Through the rigorous analysis, it is obtained that this algorithm speeds up the convergence rate of iterative learning control in the iteration domain because the closed-loop learning gain is introduced based on an open-loop iterative learning control algorithm. It is proven that this algorithm converges faster than an open-loop iterative learning control algorithm by means of a robust optimization method. Moreover, the convergence rate of the iterative learning control algorithm can be significantly accelerated by the higher closed-loop learning gain. The simulation results for a nonlinear system show the effectiveness of the algorithm

articleTitle: Adaptive Vehicle Classification Based on Information Gain and Multi-branch BP Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Vehicle classification is difficult yet important in traffic information collection based on the signal curves of loop transducer, and feature extraction and pattern recognition are both key processes in automatic vehicle classification. To reduce the information redundancy of feature set, and adapt the classifier to different application circumstance, an algorithm, which employs information gain for feature selection, is proposed. To avoid the limitations of general BP neural networks in multi-pattern recognition, such as divergence and so on, a multi-branch BP neural network, which divides an N-class problem into N parallel two-class problems, is also presented. Furthermore, experiment using actual data collected from Chinese national highway G107 is carried out, and its results show that the classifier based on information gain and multi-branch BP neural networks improves the performance and reduces the training time significantly.

articleTitle: Application and Simulation of Intelligent Ant Algorithm in Routing Choice
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: According to self-organized ability of ants, this paper described a new distributed dynamic routing method: distributed QoS-guaranteed routing algorithm (DQRA).This method aimed at the existent quantity of service in the current communication network. DQRA can resolve the problem of the delay and the bandwidth allocation parallel in the networks. It is already theoretically proved that the algorithm is simple and easy to realize. It can resolve the problem of the payload balance effectively in the large communication networks. At present, the ant algorithm has been applied to solve the problem on TSP and a series of discrete optimization successfully. It will be applied in the much wider field. The DQRA algorithm is simulated by MATLAB in order to prove its validity in this paper

articleTitle: Synchronization in Delayed Discrete-time Complex Networks
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: In this paper, we study synchronization in the delayed discrete-time complex networks. Several criterions of synchronization stability for such networks are established. And illustrative examples are presented. The numerical simulations coincide with the theoretical analysis

articleTitle: A BP Wavelet Neural Network Structure for Process Monitoring and Fault Detection
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Wavelet theory cooperated with neural networks was applied to chemical process monitoring in this contribution. A newly developed BP wavelet neural network (WNN) structure is presented. It was used to summarize the corrupted process information into a nonlinear dynamic mathematical model. The monitoring charts are based on the multivariable residuals derived from the difference between the process measurements and the wavelet network prediction. The effectiveness of the proposed method was tested through the study on Tennessee Eastman (TE) problem, and simulation was developed. The results show that the current performance of the process can be evaluated.

articleTitle: Applying Simple Adaptive Control to Power System Stabilizer
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: A conventional power-system stabilizer has some drawbacks such as the time-consuming tuning and non-optimal damping in the entire operating range. PI adaptive law in simple adaptive control (SAC) can overcome these drawbacks, but it can be only applied to the plants with almost strict positive realness and the computation of adaptive law is really complicated. A new improved SAC based on quadratic performance index was proposed and adopted to the design of power-system stabilizer. The simulation shows that this stabilizer can improve the dynamic and transient stability of the synchronous generator.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Nonlinearity Compensation Scheme for OFDM Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: An adaptive predistortion linearization is proposed to compensate for the nonlinear distortions induced by high power amplifiers (HPAs) in orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) systems. By expressing the uncertain nonlinear input-output dynamics of HPA by a new simplified Volterra series model (VSM), a predistorter (i.e., compensator) is constructed based on identification of inverse system of the HPA. Once predistorter's parameters are obtained by RLS algorithm, when OFDM signals pass through the cascade system of the predistorter and the HPA, overall linearization from predistorter input to HPA output can be achieved even if HPA is uncertain. The effectiveness of the proposed predistortion method is validated by numerical simulation for 64-ary quadrature amplitude modulation OFDM (64QAM-OFDM) transmission systems.

articleTitle: Passive Positioning Algorithm Based on Beidou Double-star
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: Aimed at the shortcomings of China's Beidou Double-star active positioning system, a new passive positioning algorithm is proposed. According to the data collected from two synchronous satellites, as well as atomic clock and altitude gauge carried by a user, passive positioning is achieved through grid search algorithm. Simulation results of the algorithm show that the method is fast and accuracy enough for real-time positioning. It is a practical way to improve the Beidou Double-star positioning system.

articleTitle: An Illumination Processing Algorithm Based on Total Variation Model
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: A processing algorithm was presented for face recognition under variation illumination. It needs only one parameter to set and can remove the "halo" efficiently. Firstly, it estimated the illumination from image using total variation model. Secondly, it recovered the image reflectance, which is invariant of illumination. Experiment results show that this algorithm can improve the face recognition rate under varying lighting conditions

articleTitle: Control a Novel Discrete Chaotic System through Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: To investigate the inherent chaotic phenomenon in genetic algorithms (GA), a novel chaos control approach through particle swarm optimization (PSO) (CCPSO) with three main processes is proposed. Firstly it detects the dynamical behaviors of a new discrete chaotic system with rational fraction in GA such as its unstable periodic points. Then it directs the chaotic system to its unstable fix point from any initial point by global controlling factors {U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</sub>} solved self-adaptively by PSO. Thirdly a multi-model solution for chaos control with double plasticity of parameter and structure generated by PSO is proposed to stabilize the system on its unstable fix point. And finally details of applying the proposed method into CCPSO are given, and experiments done show the put approach's effectiveness

articleTitle: Competition Competence Evaluation of Power Generating Enterprises using Improved Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2006 6th World Congress on Intelligent Control and Automation
abstract: With the development of electricity market reformation in China, it is especially important to evaluate the competition competence of power generating enterprises. Based on the characteristics of their, this paper bring forwards an index system to evaluate the competition competence of power generating enterprises. Improved BP neural network is introduced which is aimed at feedback lag and easily falling into the local optimal minimum. From dynamic controlling quotients, the methods at input layer and out layer errs is improved. The computation time is much shorter than tradition algorithms and the precision is relatively improved. The results show that the improved algorithm effectively reduces the training fluctuation and improves the speed. The optimum result could more easily get.
